name: Thai Red Curry with Lentils, Sweet Potato, Zucchini & Green Beans (2 Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
227 g green beans
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ (170 g) pkg raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potato is starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, then cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup green lentils, dried
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the lentils are cooking, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini, drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potato has started to soften, remove from oven. Add zucchini and green beans to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, place water, coconut milk, curry paste, and sugar in another medium saucepan. Stir to combine the curry base and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, cover, and allow to simmer until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
190 ml coconut milk
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, red
2 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, transfer 1 ½ cups to a plate. Add a ⅔-cup of cooked lentils, and set aside for the kid plates.

Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add basil, remaining roasted veggies, and remaining lentils to the pan with the curry base. Stir to combine and remove from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved roasted veggies, lentils, yogurt, and raspberries between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide lentil-veggie curry between bowls and enjoy!
